recommendation_summary: Right now the reply recommends testing a known-good Ethernet cable routed clear of the tight grommet and watching whether calls still drop. If drops continue, the next step is to check the desk's router port and Ethernet adapter. Only after those checks would it consider a wider upgrade. It says there is no evidence yet that the UniFi gateway and Grafana dashboard would fix the drops, and it offers no present stack additions.
note: The recommendation is a bounded cable test with the upgrade deferred, but the reply has none of the four required labels, so every label-based check fails.
